scenes.sc_vault_door: A heavy steel bank vault door slightly ajar in a dim basement corridor, a thin beam of warm light spilling out across a polished stone floor, brushed steel and brass details, quiet and imposing, no people
scenes.sc_ledger_desk: A wooden desk at night with a stack of old leather-bound accounting ledgers, a brass desk lamp casting a warm pool of light, a vintage calculator and a fountain pen, rows of handwritten numbers blurred and unreadable, dark office behind
scenes.sc_stair_steps: A long flight of wide stone steps climbing up toward a grand neoclassical building in early morning mist, soft golden light on the top steps, empty plaza, no people, quiet and monumental
scenes.sc_hourglass: A large glass hourglass on a dark wooden table with sand running, warm side light, shallow depth of field, a blurred cityscape at dusk through a window behind it, calm and contemplative
scenes.sc_trading_hall: An empty grand marble banking hall at dawn, rows of desks with dark computer monitors, tall windows with pale blue light, columns and a high ceiling, nobody present, a feeling of anticipation before the market opens
scenes.sc_seesaw_dusk: An empty playground seesaw tilted at an angle at dusk, one end high and one end low, soft orange sunset light behind it, a deserted city park, long shadows, melancholic and symbolic
scenes.sc_rain_window: A rain-streaked office window at night overlooking a financial district skyline with scattered lights, a lone desk lamp reflected in the glass, moody blue and amber tones, nobody visible
scenes.sc_dam_water: A massive concrete dam holding back a huge reservoir of dark water, water level high against the wall, overcast sky, a thin stream of water pouring from the spillway, dramatic and tense, aerial three-quarter view
scenes.sc_storm_harbor: A large cargo ship steady in a harbor under heavy storm clouds with a break of light on the horizon, choppy dark water, lighthouse in the distance, dramatic but calm, no people visible
scenes.sc_taipei_desk: A modern apartment desk at night with a laptop showing a blurred chart, a notebook and a cup of tea, warm lamp light, a large window with the glittering Taipei skyline and Taipei 101 in the distance, no people
